name: acererak
lore:
Beware the Devourer, for Acererak is no mere lich bound to a dusty crypt. He is a trans-planar parasite, an arch-necromancer who has transcended the need for a physical kingdom. His "ecology" is one of artificial malice; he sows the multiverse with elaborate deathtraps—not to guard treasure, but to harvest the potent souls of those brave enough to enter.

In behavior, he is a cold, mocking architect of despair. He views mortals as mere fuel for his grand experiments, treating their desperate struggles as a scholar might observe an insect in a jar. He does not seek to rule empires; he seeks to unravel the divine. Patient beyond measure, he will wait centuries for a single soul to ripen within his gauntlets. To encounter him is to realize that your life is but a footnote in a chronicle of eternal, calculated cruelty.
